About to speak on the Senate floor before we start the vote-a-rama for the Secure America Act. 

LIVE: senate.gov/legislative/floor…

The good people of South Carolina sent me to Washington for a reason. 

I will ALWAYS fight for our State and defend the Homeland. 

Never back down !

Mark Lynch calls himself a constitutional conservative. He even touts teaching classes on the Constitution…

…Grade his knowledge of the Constitution below for yourself.

Video

To my Senate colleagues: It is imperative that we understand the increasing threats to our homeland from terrorism and potential pandemics. Now is not the time to be shutting down systems that screen for potential pandemics or provide protection against the infiltration of our country by bad actors. 

Therefore I’m urging Senate leadership to set up an all-members classified briefing ASAP regarding the growing threats to our homeland. 

Time is of the essence.

While I appreciate Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s statement that the proposed weaponization fund will not be moving forward, I am still of the firm belief that there are many victims of the weaponized Biden Justice Department throughout this country.
 
To suggest nothing happened and that the Biden DOJ did not weaponize the law against Americans is inaccurate. However, creating a new system that is untested is problematic.
 
Therefore, I am proposing that we create a weaponization fund t

Congratulations to Peter McCoy on his nomination to be the next U.S. Ambassador to Montenegro.
 
Peter served our state well as a U.S. Attorney for South Carolina during President Trump’s first term. I am fully confident that he will be an exceptional advocate for our nation’s interests in the Balkans. 
 
Another outstanding pick by President Trump!


The Post and Courier (@postandcourier)

More deportations. 
No sanctuary cities!

My bill to end sanctuary cities will stop this madness once and for all.




Homeland Security (@DHSgov)

Sanctuary politicians are fighting for criminal illegal aliens. 

We’re fighting for Americans.

Sanctuary City Far left Democrat politicians are enabling these radical assaults against our law enforcement and DHS personnel.  

The men and women protecting our borders and deporting criminal illegal aliens have my full support. 

And when we pass my End Sanctuary Cities Act , any and every official protecting these criminals or ignoring ICE detainer requests will be held liable !

I would urge Trump 2 to continue that policy. Any deal that does not punish Iran in the future for supporting groups like Hezbollah — whose stated goal is to destroy Israel and control Lebanon through force of arms — would be a tremendous missed opportunity. I fully support HSI and FBI making more arrests of these SCAMMERS & FRAUDSTERS that are driving up health care costs for working American families. 

These two Minnesota fraudsters stole millions from Medicaid, a program that is meant to help Americans. 

Earlier this year, I warned Minnesota officials that the fraud must come to an end and that we will hold accountable those who ignored these scams for years. 

We are working for the taxpayers!

Video

In a recent conversation with President Trump, I affirmed my support for a deal with Iran that accepts President Trump’s demand to open up the Strait of Hormuz and start negotiations about forever ending their nuclear ambitions and support for terrorism. I have confidence that at the end of the day, President Trump will not agree to a bad deal with Iran. 

On a separate front, it is my belief that we must allow Israel to neutralize the threats the country faces from constant Hezbollah attacks em

Happy Saturday from our campaign HQ with Governor @henrymcmaster and @rosewoodpelican!

Let’s go win this thing.

Yet another tragic, real-world consequence of sanctuary city policies.

Virginia officials ignored an ICE detainer request and released him back into the community. He then allegedly sexually assaulted a woman in Arlington.

This is madness. It is dangerous. And it must end NOW. 

No more victims because sanctuary jurisdictions refuse to cooperate with ICE.

End sanctuary cities ! Pass the End Sanctuary Cities Act.

Sanctuary Cities need to pay the price for protecting illegal alien criminals. 

I stand with DHS Secretary Mullin in fighting back against radical left Democrats who are trying to stop ICE and Border Patrol from doing their job and enforce federal law. 

Organized, paid protesters in New Jersey, along with Antifa, tried to shut down an ICE facility that is holding rapists, murderers, child predators, and drug dealers – on Memorial Day. 

Enough is Enough.

I can’t believe a federal judge would deny President Trump — working with the Trump Kennedy Center Board — the ability to close the center for renovations. 

What a judicial power grab.

Thank you for your support.
